headline: range.middle
note: Written by tools/school-trips/school-city-bracket.py. The simple track of School Trips' mode-shift model: a city bracket for each budget at each city's pace in percentage points a year, a separate driving-cost row, and each budget's students out of cars split by school. Shares are percent of modelled students. Car is single-family car, the all-grade calibrated base (not the Travel Tally's 48.6% grade mix). Coverage is the share of children 5 to 17 whose home block's census point is within 1,000 ft of an all-ages line.
